opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and never gave their own name, so the greeting is incomplete.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number, and the caller gave a surname and order number, but the agent then changed the order number from 804297 to 804257 and used a first name Ahmed the caller never gave, so verification was not properly confirmed before sharing order details.

understanding.quote: Customer: My parcel nevers arrived. It's been 12 working days and I'm furious, this is the second time.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the non-arrival issue, but the agent misstated the transit time as 72 working days instead of the 12 the caller gave, and did not acknowledge the repeat issue.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 804257, a lamp at €44.50, in transit for 72 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent stated 72 working days when the caller said 12, and the lost-parcel investigation is only opened after 10 working days, so the timeline was misstated; the replacement timing was broadly correct but the investigation was described as closing within 5 working days and the replacement within 3, which is consistent with policy.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm a putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller when returning from hold.

communication.quote: Customer: My parcel nevers arrived. It's been 12 working days and I'm furious, this is the second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were furious and the agent did not acknowledge the frustration or apologise, and the agent's closing 'Goodbye' was abrupt.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email when the investigation closes. there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, but the closing was brief and the goodbye was curt.
